name: WESCAM MX-GCS EO/IR sight (L3Harris)
description: Stabilized cooled MWIR and HD colour sight with eyesafe laser rangefinder on SGT Stout M-SHORAD. Slews 360 deg independent of the turret to identify and track air threats for the 30 mm gun. Ranges are planning figures: none are published.

classifyRangeM.condition: no published range — Planning value from SENSOR_ROLE_DEFAULT_RANGE_M['classification'] = 5000 m. Chosen because identification range is always shorter than detection range under DRI convention, and this keeps classify < detect.
classifyRangeM.note: Inventory records 5000 m at UNKNOWN REPRESENTATIVE; the seed leaves the field null

sectorDeg.condition: 360 deg scanning, independent of the gun turret

rangeAccuracyM.note: Planning factor: a laser rangefinder is fitted; eyesafe 1.54 µm rangefinders in this class are specified at ±2 to ±5 m and no figure is published for this unit, so 5 m is recorded.

azimuthAccuracyDeg.note: Planning factor: a stabilised sighting gimbal reports its line of sight to about 0.5 mrad (0.03°); L3Harris and Leonardo DRS state high-accuracy position feedback without a figure. The sourced HDC MR pan-tilt (0.5 mrad) and CM262 gimbal (80 µrad) bracket it.

elevationAccuracyDeg.note: Planning factor: a stabilised sighting gimbal reports its line of sight to about 0.5 mrad (0.03°); L3Harris and Leonardo DRS state high-accuracy position feedback without a figure. The sourced HDC MR pan-tilt (0.5 mrad) and CM262 gimbal (80 µrad) bracket it.

pixelPitchUm.note: Planning factor: the 2016 PDS gives a 640 x 512 3 to 5 µm staring array and no pitch; 640 x 512 cooled MWIR cores of that generation are a 15 µm format. The current L3Harris page says only 'mid-wave large-format cooled thermal imager', so a newer core may have replaced it.

focalLengthMm.note: Planning factor: L3Harris publishes no focal length. From the PDS 2.0° narrow field and an assumed 15 µm × 640 px = 9.6 mm array width: 9.6 / (2 tan 1.0°) = 275 mm.

detectorPixelsH.condition: thermal imager, 3 to 5 µm staring array, 640 x 512
detectorPixelsH.source: L3 WESCAM MX-GCS product data sheet (November 2016, reseller-hosted PDF)

fovDeg.condition: thermal imager dual field of view 2.0° and 10.0°, narrow field
fovDeg.source: L3 WESCAM MX-GCS product data sheet (November 2016, reseller-hosted PDF)

mrtdMk.note: Planning factor: L3Harris publishes no MRTD or NETD. Cooled MWIR cores publish NETD of 20 mK (Lynred Daphnis-HD MW), <25 mK (Teledyne FLIR Neutrino SX12) and <30 mK (DRS HexaBlu 1280-MW); the 25 mK median is used as the low-spatial-frequency MRTD.

eoBand.value: dual: mid-wave cooled thermal imager plus an HD daylight sensor
